results.title: The Green–Tao theorem
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: The set of primes contains arithmetic progressions of every finite length: for every $k$ there are natural numbers $a$ and $b\ge1$ such that $a+bj$ is prime for every $j<k$.

results.title: Extraction of a progression in the set
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $A$ be a set of natural numbers, $k\ge2$, $N\ge1$, $\alpha>0$, $W>0$ and $b$ natural. If the off-diagonal mass of the weight of $A$ is positive, then $A$ contains a $k$-term arithmetic progression: there are natural numbers $a'$ and $d'>0$ with $a'+jd'\in A$ for every $j<k$.

Let $S$ be the set of primes $p\in A$ with $\lfloor X/4\rfloor<p\le X$. results.title: Transference for every large prime modulus
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For $k\ge3$ let $\alpha_k>0$ be the scale of the W-tricked prime weight in the Green–Tao proof (the constant fixed there from $k$ and the normalizer of the smooth sieve cutoff, small enough that the weight lies below the sieve majorant). For $f:\mathbb Z/N\to\mathbb R$ write $\mathbb E f=\frac1N\sum_nf(n)$ and $\Lambda_k(f)=\mathbb E_{a,d\in\mathbb Z/N}\prod_{j<k}f(a+jd)$.

results.title: Progressions in a set of primes with mass in dyadic windows
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $A$ be a set of primes and $c_1>0$ such that $\#(A\cap(\lfloor Z/2\rfloor,Z])\ge c_1Z/\log Z$ for infinitely many $Z$. Then for every $k$ the set $A$ contains a $k$-term arithmetic progression: there are natural numbers $a$ and $d>0$ with $a+jd\in A$ for every $j<k$.

results.title: Szemerédi's theorem in the primes holds
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Every set of primes of positive relative upper density contains arithmetic progressions of every finite length.
